title: An agent-executed, preregistered reproduction pipeline for BAO cosmology with kernel-checked model identities: three preregistered DESI/SDSS reproductions and one earlier reproduction as one methodology study
description:
We describe and audit a reproduction pipeline for baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) cosmology in which the analysis is executed by language-model agents (Claude, orchestrated by the author), every number is produced by a script in the repository, targets and tolerances are preregistered from the source papers, the algebraic skeleton of each closed-form model is kernel-checked in Lean 4 (28 theorems, trusted axioms only, checked in two Mathlib builds where possible), claims are filed in a tier-capped ledger, and an adversarial model referee re-runs each analysis before a fix round. The paper itself went through three rounds of three independent model referees.

Results (reproductions, not new measurements): DESI DR2 flat LCDM Omega_m = 0.29781 ± 0.00856, h r_d = 101.530 ± 0.732 Mpc, wCDM w = -0.9164 ± 0.0787 (14/14 preregistered criteria); BAO+BBN inverse distance ladder with an exact CAMB sound horizon H0 = 68.545 ± 0.594 km/s/Mpc vs DESI's 68.51 ± 0.58 (PASS), with the DR1 check PARTIAL and shown to depend on the numerical environment; SDSS/eBOSS DR16 Omega_m = 0.2987 ± 0.0164 and an SDSS vs DESI DR2 consistency of 0.88 sigma (a lower bound, overlap ignored). A Rust/CVODE port (rusty-SUNDIALS qf-bao-distances) reproduces the DR2 fit and exposed a solver defect that was fixed.

Limitations stated in the paper: no component has been reviewed by a person (all audits are by a model); preregistrations were not git-committed before the fits; the ledger's Tier B does not follow Elenchus's exact-arithmetic definition; a DR1 chi-squared offset of 0.08 is unexplained.
notes: AI use: the analyses, Lean formalisation, paper drafting and referee rounds were executed by Claude agents orchestrated by the author. Code: github.com/xaviercallens/AutoevolveAI (branch worktree-cosmo3-run, release v13.3.0) and github.com/xaviercallens/rusty-SUNDIALS (PRs #60, #61).

# AutoevolveAI BAO cosmology reproductions (2026-09)

Data and artifacts behind the paper *An agent-executed, preregistered reproduction pipeline for BAO cosmology with kernel-checked model identities* (Xavier Callens, SocrateAI Lab; analysis executed by Claude agents).

## Contents
- `cosmo_synthesis.pdf`: the paper (26 pages, three rounds of three model referees; review trail inside the bundle).
- `autoevolve_bao_cosmology_2026-09.tar.gz`: results (fit.json, controls, preregistrations and the H0 protocol amendment, Elenchus ledgers with evidence blobs), scripts, papers, Lean 4 sources, literature reviews.
- `MANIFEST.json`: sha256 and size of every file in the bundle.
- `jepa_episodes/cosmo3_2026-09-27.jsonl`: 206 verdict-bearing pipeline steps (173 pass / 33 fail) as JEPA rows with 1024-d qwen3-embedding hidden states. Training on them did **not** beat a shuffled-label control; they are shared as labelled data, not as a trained result.

## Headline numbers (reproductions of published values)
| problem | result | published |
|---|---|---|
| DESI DR2 flat LCDM Omega_m | 0.29781 +- 0.00856 | 0.2975 +- 0.0086 |
| DESI DR2 h r_d [Mpc] | 101.530 +- 0.732 | 101.54 +- 0.73 |
| DESI DR2 wCDM w | -0.9164 +- 0.0787 | -0.916 +- 0.078 |
| BAO+BBN H0 [km/s/Mpc] | 68.545 +- 0.594 | 68.51 +- 0.58 |
| SDSS/eBOSS DR16 Omega_m | 0.2987 +- 0.0164 | 0.299 +- 0.016 |

## Honest limitations
No person has audited any component; the DR1 H0 check is PARTIAL and environment-dependent; preregistrations were not committed before the fits. Input data are the public DESI DR1/DR2 and SDSS BAO likelihood files (see the literature reviews for sources).
